collections.name: Magic Wing'SZ by Su
collections.description:
Welcome to the Magic Wing'S Collection.. 
The bird species with 77+7 separate magic wings will be with you. Every bird you see here is hand-drawn, each one has its own story. Each hue, every brush mark has meaning. They have some secret and very special seals on them. Also some birds will have jewel feathers. The glitter in the background, the glitter and the branches on which some birds are on represent an diamond, which is one of the hidden features of this collection that will be explained after some time has passed. Let me tell you one more secret, the theme in the background is entirely created with the art of alcoholic ink. And each background is actually the colors in the bird's soul, the colors of its aura. You can unravel these secrets in their original stories.
 I believe we all have wings in our souls. We're actually a lot like birds. Some of us live in droves, some of us are on our own. We're all very special. Discover the wings in your soul and let's fly together!

collections.name: Simultaneity
collections.description:
Eye Of The Universe - Simultaneity It is a 1/1 unique collection. The numbers in the titles have special meanings. Intuitive. It doesn't specify which one. each produced individually. This collection describes the Sunset and the Sunrise happening at the same time.
No past, no future. Birth and death.  Good and bad. Separation and reunion. Beginning and end. Sometimes, or maybe in a different universe, even if they're opposites, these words mean the same thing. The sun rises, the sun sets. And sometimes we experience each one at the same time. Nothing's started, nothing's going to end. EVERYTHING'S SIMULTANEITY.
Sometimes when we  say it's all over, it starts again and the Sun rises at Sunset. Sımultaneıty.... 
Creator: Büşra Su HAYDAR

collections.name: MAKE A WISH! by Su
collections.description:
Isn't even making a wish exciting our little hearts? Imagine if your wish came true. , I produced all of these artworks with digital hand drawing. I drew each of these Stars in all encoded each one individually by listening to the miracle frequency 7 7 7 and encoded with a Special number sequence to make the wishes of the individual owner come true. There are only 177 of these magic Stars and they are waiting to make your wishes come true. Please don't forget to make a wish before you get your Star.

I believe wishing is a spiritual need. The fact that wishing for a wish while the Star is sliding is still going on from the 1st century onwards seems to be proof of this... 

What do you want most?  MAKE A WISH!  And watch it happen..  7 7 7 


Creator: Büşra Su HAYDAR

Su's iconic brushstrokes are 1/1 unique and unrepeatable, blending traditional and digital painting techniques. (NEVER AI!)

SUrreal thoughts & feels transform into tangible representations, leaving their mark as digital identities with unique color palettes and styles.

Even the same tones can create different stories. It hits deep. Infinite possibility of variation. That's why Su's passion,because it's impossible to ever do the same brushstroke exactly the same way again. And each brushstroke represents a possibility suspended in time.

This collection is an intuitive universe that holds infinite possibilities. Hidden within are unique Soul(S), Stories, emotionS, questionS, traceS, secretS.. Cosmic, collective, undefined memory. SU'rreal Big Bang explores the evolution of meaning transforming into form through Su's magical toucheS…

Su's iconic brushstrokes are 1/1 unique and unrepeatable, blending traditional and digital painting techniques. (NEVER AI!)

SUrreal thoughts & feels transform into tangible representations, leaving their mark as digital identities with unique color palettes and styles.

Even the same tones can create different stories. It hits deep. Infinite possibility of variation. That's why Su's passion,because it's impossible to ever do the same brushstroke exactly the same way again. And each brushstroke represents a possibility suspended in time.

This collection is an intuitive universe that holds infinite possibilities. Hidden within are unique Soul(S), Stories, emotionS, questionS, traceS, secretS.. Cosmic, collective, undefined memory. SU'rreal Big Bang explores the evolution of meaning transforming into form through Su's magical toucheS…

This collection was created using a custom smart contract developed exclusively for this project. All artworks belong to the same universe while carrying distinct visual and conceptual traits. Designed as an open structure, this universe allows new and different traits to emerge over time.

Created by @busrasuhaydar

Su's iconic brushstrokes are 1/1 unique and unrepeatable, blending traditional and digital painting techniques. (NEVER AI!)

SUrreal thoughts & feels transform into tangible representations, leaving their mark as digital identities with unique color palettes and styles.

Even the same tones can create different stories. It hits deep. Infinite possibility of variation. That's why Su's passion,because it's impossible to ever do the same brushstroke exactly the same way again. And each brushstroke represents a possibility suspended in time.

This collection is an intuitive universe that holds infinite possibilities. Hidden within are unique Soul(S), Stories, emotionS, questionS, traceS, secretS.. Cosmic, collective, undefined memory. SU'rreal Big Bang explores the evolution of meaning transforming into form through Su's magical toucheS…

This collection was created using a custom smart contract developed exclusively for this project. All artworks belong to the same universe while carrying distinct visual and conceptual traits. Designed as an open structure, this universe allows new and different traits to emerge over time.

Created by @busrasuhaydar

Su's iconic brushstrokes are 1/1 unique and unrepeatable, blending traditional and digital painting techniques. (NEVER AI!)

SUrreal thoughts & feels transform into tangible representations, leaving their mark as digital identities with unique color palettes and styles.

Even the same tones can create different stories. It hits deep. Infinite possibility of variation. That's why Su's passion,because it's impossible to ever do the same brushstroke exactly the same way again. And each brushstroke represents a possibility suspended in time.

This collection is an intuitive universe that holds infinite possibilities. Hidden within are unique Soul(S), Stories, emotionS, questionS, traceS, secretS.. Cosmic, collective, undefined memory. SU'rreal Big Bang explores the evolution of meaning transforming into form through Su's magical toucheS…

This collection was created using a custom smart contract developed exclusively for this project. All artworks belong to the same universe while carrying distinct visual and conceptual traits. Designed as an open structure, this universe allows new and different traits to emerge over time.

Created by @busrasuhaydar

Su's iconic brushstrokes are 1/1 unique and unrepeatable, blending traditional and digital painting techniques. (NEVER AI!)

SUrreal thoughts & feels transform into tangible representations, leaving their mark as digital identities with unique color palettes and styles.

Even the same tones can create different stories. It hits deep. Infinite possibility of variation. That's why Su's passion,because it's impossible to ever do the same brushstroke exactly the same way again. And each brushstroke represents a possibility suspended in time.

This collection is an intuitive universe that holds infinite possibilities. Hidden within are unique Soul(S), Stories, emotionS, questionS, traceS, secretS.. Cosmic, collective, undefined memory. SU'rreal Big Bang explores the evolution of meaning transforming into form through Su's magical toucheS…

This collection was created using a custom smart contract developed exclusively for this project. All artworks belong to the same universe while carrying distinct visual and conceptual traits. Designed as an open structure, this universe allows new and different traits to emerge over time.

Created by @busrasuhaydar

items.name: THE LIVELY & COLORFUL GHOST SCULPTURE
items.description:
First and foremost, this work is an attempt by an artist who hates every concept, every image that evokes death, and all the dark narratives woven around it, to confront her own perception of death and the representations of death that have been established for centuries; to challenge them and to attempt to give death a new meaning.

This Ghost is an interactive body capable of moving against the traditional image of death: an 85-centimeter skeleton, yet a carrier not of darkness, but of color.

The Ghost has been created from more than 1,000 unique pieces of paint created using specialized techniques that cover its surface. None of them is the same in form or tone. Each one is the trace of a memory, a question, a wound, a feeling, a lesson, an encounter, or a transformation.. Just as what constitutes a human being is not a single story, but countless experiences accumulated one upon another..


Chromatic Dream.. is the first and most successful result of an obsession that the artist Su has had for years, through countless experiments. At home, using harmless chemicals according to general application methods, she finally achieved a professional mirror reflection. And she turned her Ghost into a mirror. Thus, the work does not only reflect itself; it also includes the person standing before it within its own ontology…… In this way, death here ceases to be an ending; it becomes the reflection we leave behind on those who remain alive..

At the same time, the artist may possibly have achieved something for the first time in the world using the pieces of paint on this Ghost. Partial and gradient chrome has been applied to paint pieces this small. This has made the entire Ghost even more unique. (-a patent application has been filed.)

But what is inside the Ghost is more complex than what is outside……



The mind of the Living Colorful Ghost:

Going deep is dangerous. It is forbidden. Because a human being does not know what they will find at the bottom of their own mind..

When the skull is opened, the depths of the mind become visible. In the depths of holographic letters, colors, questions, answers, brushstrokes, and fragments of glass representing thought, a diver appears, searching for meaning….

The diver is the representation of a consciousness that continually descends deeper into the mind, searching for meaning not on the surface, but within the dark layers of thought.

Because the mind is made up not only of what we think, but also of what we remember, what we cannot forget, what we suppress, and what we try to make sense of.. Wish the Diver luck, the work is difficult..

Because a person may believe they know themselves on the surface.

But when they descend into their own depths, they see how fragile and changeable all the definitions they have constructed about themselves can be..

The mind is the place where a human being is reborn within themselves endlessly.. just like the heart.




The heart of the Living Colorful Ghost:

The heart never accepts separation..

Because for the heart, love is not dependent on the condition of existence.

But sometimes separation and longing become so heavy that the heart no longer fits inside the rib cage. That is why the Ghost has allowed its heart to become a flying balloon.

The Ghost’s flying-balloon heart drifts through the air with the wind, its string still tied to its wrist.

This string is not the fine line of possession, but the fine line of love. Because sometimes loving means not holding on, but being able to let go..

As the Ghost releases its heart to the wind with the pain of separation, it takes with it the final wound that will never close. The miniature repairman is not trying to repair the wound; he is only helping to keep it from opening any further.

Because sometimes the heart can reach the purest form of love only when it learns to let go..




Waiting:

Inside the throat, behind a window, there is a woman screaming: the place where the unsaid are kept within the body.

Inside the rib cage, there is a bench, a pigeon, and a woman waiting beneath her favorite tree; while the firefighter approaching her from outside points to an invisible fire that is still being fought, still being put out.


All these pieces touch one another within the Ghost, not as separate stories, but as layers of the same body that carries human existence. The mind deepens, the heart attaches and lets go, the throat keeps what cannot be said, and the rib cage carries waiting and invisible fires. From the outside, there is only a skeleton; inside, however, there is a living universe made of memories, wounds, questions, longings, and transformations.

Color is the language of the Ghost’s existence. Although divided into thousands of pieces, each piece preserves its own form and its own tone. None of them is identical to another. Perhaps a human being is the same: what makes us who we are is not how much we resemble the world, but how vividly we can keep the color that belongs to us alive within ourselves.

For this reason, the Ghost does not merely stand against the established image of death; it also stands against everything that forces a human being to give up their own color. Time, loss, fear, expectations, the gaze of others, the roles imposed upon us, or the darkness that life leaves upon us does not have to erase the color we carry within.

It is not a coincidence that it gives our own reflection back to us through its chrome surface. The Ghost includes everyone who looks at it among these colors and quietly reminds them:

Keep your own color. Do not hide it. Do not let it fade. Do not let anything, or anyone, turn you into a color other than your own.

Because perhaps the most original trace a human being can leave in the world is to preserve their own color forever, while also being able to add color to the worlds of others.

And that is precisely why the Ghost continues to live: Its colors are still touching one another, changing one another, and multiplying one another. The body that was once expected to be nothing more than a skeleton has now become life itself.


Stay colorful, human,
Stay colorful, world.

With love,
Su

then it's artwork,

items.name: SU'rreal Piano Simulation
items.description:
SU’rreal Piano is a universe where sounds can be seen, colors can be heard, multilayered, filled with water and secrets, alive and capable of evolving.

SU’rreal Piano is the first water-based instrument that aims to activate the brain’s multisensory integration capacity and transform the experience into a pure omnisensory universe.

7 notes, 16 keys, 3 octaves, 48 tones. And 7 seconds. 7 seconds, the entire life of 7 notes. Infinite feeling.
Can you compose by painting the water with color and sound?

Each of the 7 notes is a story, each story a thousand emotions, each emotion a color, each color finds its own sound through touch. Each sound is in the frequency of its own color, each frequency is seen and heard directly in your heart.

Just touch and color the silence of this unique universe..

Through Su’s personal taste, vision, and synthesis of scientific and philosophical research, in this living universe where sound and color frequencies merge with magic, each note gives its real color to water.

Based on Su’s special traditional art techniques, it creates generative art that is conscious, deliberately limited, yet holds infinite possibilities within itself. The shape, speed, intensity of the brushstrokes and all parameters are created in real time from the frequencies of that note.

As both a rebellion against and a tribute to the loneliness that art brings, a colorful ghost has been invited into this universe. An artist lives inside the SU’rreal Piano, the colorful ghost, ready to play all the songs you wish for, as long as you are gentle enough to accompany it.

Before discovering the keyboard equivalents of the piano notes, one important piece of information: In this piano, there are no black keys, no half octaves. No grey areas, no indecisive sounds, no in-between vibrations are allowed. With the manifesto of limitation, grey is once again challenged. Creativity is sometimes born from boundaries, from difficulties, from impossibilities.

A personal note: I have never owned a piano, but by the time I reached the end of creating this universe, I learned all the notes and how to play the piano thanks to SU’rreal Piano.. I believe that through the missing half octaves, the most complete composition can be made…

TOUCH!:
C3 = z, D3 = x, E3 = c, F3 = v, G3 = b, A3 = n, B3 = m, C4 = a, D4 = s, E4 = d, 
F4 = f, G4 = g, A4 = h, B4 = j, C5 = k, D5 = l

(The key for experiencing the higher and lower octaves will be shared only with the collector.)

To explore the depths of this multilayered artwork: https://busrasuhaydar.com/

Love, SU

items.name: ?WAR&PEACE? (physical sculpture)
items.description:
?War&Peace…………..?  

(For detailed photos and videos of these multi-dimensional sculptures created with unique techniques; https://busrasuhaydar.com/warpeace-2/)


Peace in the language of colourS: an aesthetic manifesto of opposition to war..  
The role of colourS in the stand against war creates a unique language.


The world’s greatest war and peace are fought in the mind War begets peace. Peace is sometimes the cause of war. In order to continue living, perhaps, war and peace are alwayS at the same moment. Simultaneity.

Sometimes the war is with human oneself. And sometimes it is the people oneself who needs to be reconciled the most. Sometimes the war with oneself is fought with the other people. Sometimes when one forgives and reconciles with the other people, one can make peace with oneself. Thoughts are mirror shards in our heads. The more they hit each other, the sharper they become, the more they shatter. And one thought reflects itself in another. Thoughts are mirror shards.

They hurt.

Where it cuts, it leaves a scar.

In all wars in the world and outside the world, children are the only thing we need to ensure that they are excluded. Children and war should never be mentioned in the same sentence, under any circumstances. Peace is mostly for children. For all the children of the World! Peace is for childhood.. 

War and peace change everything. It is a flow. But there are things that will never change. The ones that leave a trace..

Stereotypes, traumas, beliefs passed down through genes, memories, the greatest joys and the most painful things… These things never change. That’s why black silhouettes of people represent our dark side, the unchangeability. He is asking for forgiveness, but no matter what color you put into black, black is black. It doesn’t change. In war or peace..

The big old fat world can’t take these wars anymore. It is carrying them. The world is overflowing. The world can’t take the wars anymore.

There’s only water left behind. The water of this Earth is like the Akashic Records, it has all the history of this realm, it is something that reminds and awakens us of our true self, it is a channel of communication, a song of truth, like a heartbeat. The water has all the history of this Earth within it….  
Water holds all the memorieS.

We should embrace the war and peace in the mind with love, which has been since the first human being and will continue as long as the human mind continues to function.

People is very similar to the earth. We have layers like the earth. And our core is the essence of our soul.

The role of colourS in the stand against war creates a unique language..

If we can’t stop the war inside our heads, it will come out.  But in some cases, even if it is difficult to accept, one always seeks peace. This is one of the most important reasons why there are 3 layers in this work, the passion for peace in spite of war. Peace in the language of colourS, white people as a strong expression of anti-war feelings. Whiteness represents peace and the essence of the soul. By using colourful and more static people, the desire to stand together against the destructive effects of war is shown. By using their colours in their manifestos, the essence of souls standing against the hardships of war emphasise the importance of peace and unity.  And this artwork reveals the emotional and artistic unity of societys at war for peace.  
To all those around the world who are experiencing war in their minds, I wish first individual peace and then world peace for every society. A new world where minds are free and peaceful..

We are sensitive and fragile like glass. Collectively, we are inside our own lanterns. Layers inside us too. Delicate, fragile. But how transparent are we really?

Our eyes are mirrors, if only we knew how to look. If we wanted to see.

Our core is the essence of our soul..

The essence will shine as long as there is war and peace.

Even when one day the light is extinguished, its trace will remain.

Perhaps in someone else’s mind.

But the trace will remain. the trace will remain….

a ray of hope shines in the lost galaxies in my eyes. While the purple winds soothe my soul.  
When will the mystery of eternity be solved?

This painting was made with the Special techniques of the artist Su, using mixed media on wood canvas.  Original Swarovski stone is used. Everything is completely hand drawn and hand painted. 

And the NFT version is the original unprocessed photograph of the physical canvas.    
Orginal physical painting will be sent to the NFT owner. 

For questions, address information and everything you are curious about, you can contact me at busrasuuhaydar@gmail.com or via social media accounts.

Love,Su🪶

items.name: ARKHE
items.description:
ARKHE...

ARKHE?  Is it the birth of an endless water heralding Spring?

This Artwork will be dynamic & interactive in real time.  Birth and beyond.  Beginning, and Spring. 


'ARKHE' which has an important role in the development of metaphysics, which is considered the main discipline of philosophy, and generally Science, especially physical science, means the beginning and the first element.

The first question of philosophy is 'ARKHE'?  
What is the first cause that provided the existence of everything in the universe?


Hundreds of philosophers have different answers to this question.  Artist Su' mostly adopted and internalized Thales' idea.  (Perhaps because of the meaning of her name and her favorite thing in life is water.)

According to Thales, the first matter or ARKHE that formed the universe was Water.  Because he claimed that everything needs water and that if there was no water, nothing would happen.  Water is the main substance that does not change but all other beings are born from and return to itself.


But when Su was searching for 'ARKHE' with her art, her answer was 'BIRTH'.

Su'rreal worldS in a Real Living BrushStrokeS. 

THE  'ARKHE' is drawn and painted with Special techniqueS of Artist Su, which emerges with the unique dance of traditional and  digital art..  love, SU🪶

items.name: Cockatiel Parrot
items.description:
Each unique bird species is first hand-drawn on paper and then digitized on the ipad. 2400x2400 pixel, 300 dpi.
They have some secret and very special seals on them. Also some birds will have jewel feathers. The glitter in the background, the glitter and the branches on which some birds are on represent an diamond, which is one of the hidden features of this collection that will be explained after some time has passed. Let me tell you one more secret, the theme in the background is entirely created with the art of alcoholic ink. And each background is actually the colors in the bird's soul, the colors of its aura. items.name: EYE OF THE UNIVERSE - Simultaneity #1
items.description: This collection describes the Sunset and the Sunrise happening at the same time. No past, no future. Birth and death. Good and bad. Separation and reunion. Beginning and end. Sometimes, or maybe in a different universe, even if they're opposites, these words mean the same thing. The sun rises, the sun sets. And sometimes we experience each one at the same time. Nothing's started, nothing's going to end. EVERYTHING'S SIMULTANEITY. In this collection, I used only 1 shade of each color in each work. This collection consists of only 7 colors. Pink, Purple, Turquoise, Orange, Black, White, Gray. Light and shadow... It made the colors change in thousands of shades. Some of the artifacts are very dark, some are very bright. Sometimes we wake up to dark days, like the Sun goes down before it even comes up. Or so we think. Sometimes when we say it's all over, it starts again and the Sun rises at Sunset. Or so we think. Sımultaneıty.... Creator: Büşra Su HAYDAR

items.name: EYE OF THE UNIVERSE - Simultaneity #27
items.description:
This collection describes the Sunset and the Sunrise happening at the same time.
No past, no future. Birth and death.  Good and bad. Separation and reunion. Beginning and end. Sometimes, or maybe in a different universe, even if they're opposites, these words mean the same thing. The sun rises, the sun sets. And sometimes we experience each one at the same time. Nothing's started, nothing's going to end. EVERYTHING'S SIMULTANEITY.
In this collection, I used only 1 shade of each color in each work. This collection consists of only 7 colors.  Pink, Purple, Turquoise, Orange, Black, White, Gray.  Light and shadow...  It made the colors change in thousands of shades. Some of the artifacts are very dark, some are very bright.  Sometimes we wake up to dark days, like the Sun goes down before it even comes up. Or so we think. Sometimes when we  say it's all over, it starts again and the Sun rises at Sunset. Or so we think. Sımultaneıty.... 
Creator: Büşra Su HAYDAR
items.file: Simultaneity/EYE OF THE UNIVERSE - Simultaneity #27 [428].jpg

items.name: EYE OF THE UNIVERSE - Simultaneity #89
items.description: This collection describes the Sunset and the Sunrise happening at the same time. No past, no future. Birth and death. Good and bad. Separation and reunion. Beginning and end. Sometimes, or maybe in a different universe, even if they're opposites, these words mean the same thing. The sun rises, the sun sets. And sometimes we experience each one at the same time. Nothing's started, nothing's going to end. EVERYTHING'S SIMULTANEITY. In this collection, I used only 1 shade of each color in each work. This collection consists of only 7 colors. Pink, Purple, Turquoise, Orange, Black, White, Gray. Light and shadow... It made the colors change in thousands of shades. Some of the artifacts are very dark, some are very bright. Sometimes we wake up to dark days, like the Sun goes down before it even comes up. Or so we think. Sometimes when we say it's all over, it starts again and the Sun rises at Sunset. Or so we think. Sımultaneıty.... Creator: Büşra Su HAYDAR

items.name: AURORA IN EGYPT
items.description:
Why is the Aurora light only at the north pole?  What would it be like elsewhere?  Where is the Aurora really?

Where Is the Aurora?

 Now in Egypt!

 With the fire of orange and scarlet.
 The colors of the aurora reflect the energy and aura of the country in which it is located.  Colors feel its warmth and mystical power.
 The main character's name is Aurora.
 She brings her light to the country her is in.
 She's a painter, and she leaves brushstrokes on countries.  Aurora dreams of a new world to be lost or found in.
 Sometimes it makes the concrete abstract, sometimes it makes the abstract concrete.
 Every tone she uses, every brushstroke has a meaning.  You will see all the special details of Egypt as you go deeper.

 Open your eyes and imagine a world where anything is possible.  Don't be afraid to get lost, Aurora will be your guide.


The Where Is Aurora collection is drawn and painted with special techniques of Artist Su, which emerges with the unique dance of digital and traditional art..
